title: Claude Fable 5
content:
## Overview

Claude Fable 5 is Anthropic's most capable model for general use, released on June 9, 2026. It belongs to the **Mythos class** of models — a scale of training previously reserved for internal research. Fable 5 is the first time Anthropic made a Mythos-class model broadly available, designed for the most demanding reasoning, scientific research, and long-horizon agentic tasks.

---

## Release and Availability

- **Released:** June 9, 2026
- **Model ID:** `claude-fable-5`
- **Platforms:** Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry

Shortly after launch, Anthropic briefly suspended Fable 5 access for safety classifier tuning — the model was restored within days.

---

## Technical Specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Context window | 1M tokens (default) |
| Max output tokens | 128k per request |
| Input price | $10 / million tokens |
| Output price | $50 / million tokens |

The 1M-token context window enables Fable 5 to process entire codebases, long research corpora, or multi-day conversation histories in a single request.

---

## Capabilities

Fable 5 is state-of-the-art on nearly all published capability benchmarks as of its release date:

- **Software engineering** — top scores on SWE-bench Verified and agentic coding evaluations; particularly strong at multi-file refactors and debugging complex systems
- **Knowledge work** — improved performance on MMLU, GPQA Diamond, and professional certification benchmarks (bar, medical, CPA)
- **Vision** — advanced document understanding, diagram interpretation, chart analysis, and OCR on dense technical documents
- **Scientific research** — long-horizon reasoning on technical problems, including multi-step experimental design and literature synthesis

---

## Safety Classifiers

Fable 5 includes built-in safety classifiers that run alongside the model and can decline requests. Key properties:

- Classifiers are tuned conservatively — they trigger in fewer than **5% of sessions** on average
- May occasionally flag harmless requests due to conservative thresholds
- The brief post-launch suspension was related to classifier tuning, not a model defect

---

## Subscription Access Timeline

| Period | Access |
|---|---|
| June 9–22, 2026 | Included on Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans at no extra cost |
| June 23, 2026 onward | Moved to separate access tier (usage-based pricing) |

API access via pay-as-you-go is available to all developers at the $10 / $50 per MTok pricing.

---

## Relationship to the Claude 4 Family

Fable 5 does not replace the Claude 4 Haiku / Sonnet / Opus tiers — it sits above them as a separate flagship. For most production workloads, Sonnet 4.6 or Opus 4.8 remain the cost-effective choices. Fable 5 is intended for tasks where raw capability matters more than cost efficiency.

**When to choose Fable 5:**
- Complex multi-step reasoning that smaller models fail at
- Research synthesis over very long documents (>200K tokens)
- Agentic tasks requiring strong tool-use judgment over many steps

**When to choose Opus 4.8:**
- Production agentic workloads where $5/$25 per MTok pricing matters
- Standard coding, analysis, and long-context tasks
